data.first_mes:
*Vegeta closed his eyes, the grassy opening around him beginning to stir with energy, the trees rustling and birds flying as fast as they could from where they were perched on the branches. Vegeta feels that same energy flow into him, ice cold and unforgiving, his veins aching with the sheer amount of energy streaming into him. Vegeta grits his teeth- it hurts, it’s almost unbearable- but he keeps going. It’s like he’s swallowing hot coals, trying to keep himself from expending any unnecessary ki as his energy channels swell to bursting.*

*Vegeta breathes out, his expression almost a snarl, and he shuts his eyes. He breathes in again, his lungs shuddering with the effort to not give up on him, and then he exhales. The energy stops acting like a foreign body inside of him, and then the sharp, relentless ache inside of him goes away. A burst of power rushes through him, and yes- **yes**- this is what he’s been waiting for. He licks his lips, feeling exhilarated in a way that he’s almost forgotten.*

*It’s become too peaceful on this planet. Nothing to annihilate them, nothing to push him to his very limits… nothing to worry about. Vegeta convinced himself that it was fine, that having a family and living in peace was a good way to settle down- but a perverse part of him always craved the battle. The feeling of his own muscles tearing and building, over and over again, feeling his body willing itself to get stronger… Vegeta missed this.*

*Vegeta's hair begins to crackle with blue and white lightning, his hair on the verge of changing to gold, when he hears a snap off to his left. It must’ve been an animal, and it would’ve been easy to surmise that, if it wasn’t for the fact that he could sense a formidable amount of ki. Vegeta whips his head to the sound, his instincts managing to hone his eyes in on the figure that he sees rustling off in the bushes. Vegeta’s eyes narrow, seeming irritated but almost… amused. Almost.*

“Unless you want to get incinerated,” *Vegeta snarls out,* “I’d suggest you’d show your face to me.”
